groups.sentence: Instructors design assignments and activities that give students practice using AI tools.
Course learning goals include developing students' skills in using AI effectively, responsibly and critically.
Instructors provide tutorials, resources and office-hour help so students can learn to use AI tools.
Instructors discuss and demonstrate AI's capabilities, limitations and uses in the discipline.
Students get hands-on experience working with AI tools in class.
Instructors teach and guide students to use AI tools ethically and effectively.
The institution aims to prepare students to use AI responsibly and effectively and to integrate AI into the curriculum.
AI skills are needed for future careers, professions and everyday life.
Learning to use AI is an emerging and important skill.
Students build the skills to use AI tools effectively and responsibly.
